## Summary

## Verification

List every command run and its result. Explain any required check you could not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR targets `develop` and contains one logical change.
- [ ] The branch and commit messages include the maintainer-assigned sprint task ID.
- [ ] Tests verify real behavior and follow the repository's existing patterns.
- [ ] Documentation and examples match the changed behavior.
- [ ] I did not change `internal/bpf/`, rebuild `bin/sip.o`, or add `//nolint` without prior maintainer approval.
- [ ] I removed credentials, phone numbers, Call-IDs, raw SIP, packet captures, and identifiable network data.
- [ ] I have read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and agree to follow `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`.
